hooks.prompt: If this is a KOS_LLM-Wiki vault session (check for _meta/ directory or CLAUDE.md), silently read _meta/hot.md to restore recent context. If _meta/hot.md does not exist, do nothing. Do not announce this. Do not report what you read. Just have the context available.
Hook-injected context does not survive context compaction. If _meta/hot.md exists, silently re-read it now to restore the hot cache. Do not announce this.

hooks.command: cd "$PWD" && if [ -f .vault-meta/session-changes.log ]; then CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^(_meta|0 Inbox|1 Projects|2 Areas|3 Resources|AGENTS\.md|CLAUDE\.md|en/|zh-tw/)' || true); if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" -gt 0 ]; then FILE_LIST=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(_meta|0 Inbox|1 Projects|2 Areas|3 Resources|AGENTS\.md|CLAUDE\.md|en/|zh-tw/)' | head -20 | sed 's/^/- /'); echo "VAULT_CHANGED: $CHANGED_FILES files modified this session."; echo "$FILE_LIST"; echo "Update _meta/hot.md with brief summary (under 500 words). Use: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads, Session State. Overwrite completely."; fi; rm -f .vault-meta/session-changes.log 2>/dev/null; fi || true
